name: u1-print-studio
description: Prepare Snapmaker U1 work and monitor it through a desktop-local read-only connector with interactive and inline-image status cards.

interface.longDescription: U1 Print Studio uses one desktop-local setup and doctor path with no normal-user Tailscale, DNS, OAuth, environment-file, or Bun requirement. It keeps preparation and authorized print start separate while exposing read-only U1 status, snapshots, and bounded live camera signaling through the MCP Apps bridge.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this model for my Snapmaker U1.
Monitor my U1 print with adaptive status cards.
